name: groundwork
description: Codex-native personal R&D workflow base for PRD, task slicing, planning, prototypes, implementation, verification, handoff, dispatch, and project wiki knowledge artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: A personal R&D base for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Groundwork is a Codex-native personal R&D base for turning PRD/spec intent into managed tasks, grounding execution in project evidence, selecting the lightest execution path, preserving project wiki knowledge artifacts, and producing verified deliverables.
defaultPrompt: Use Groundwork only when context, risk, or reuse justifies a workflow.
For raw requirements, PRD/spec drafting, or explicit grill-me/challenge/clarify requests, enter Codex Plan Mode first when the host exposes it.

Use Plan Mode to run the Groundwork entry decision, lifecycle preflight, shared grilling gate, and PRD scope before drafting or asking; if Plan Mode is unavailable, state the prompt-level planning fallback without claiming tool-enforced plan-mode evidence.
Use Groundwork dispatch to route accepted ready tasks without executing them.
Use Groundwork to verify an issue or prepare a handoff.
